verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for a payments platform like Adyen for Platforms, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers onboarding, split payments, payouts, webhooks and the MCP server, but nothing documents retention settings, deletion requests or data-purge controls. Account-closure webhooks are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
